audit.summary: The current constrained decoder returns global termination when one full-search branch has no child, even if sibling prefixes remain on its stack. A finite grammar gives an exact missed-solution witness; practical mesh-generation frequency and benchmark effects remain unmeasured.

proposition.claim: The paper describes backtracking to alternative branches. During the full-candidate pass, the author function returns termination whenever the current prefix has no children, without checking whether its depth-first stack still contains siblings.
